name: Character
overview: Scripture reveals that character is demonstrated through steadfastness and moral integrity, as seen in Noah who was described as just and upright, walking faithfully with God. Conversely, weakness of character leads to downfall, exemplified by Reuben's instability and Pharaoh's hardened heart, which resisted God's commands. The story of Joseph also highlights the importance of resisting temptation to maintain godly character. These passages collectively emphasize that true character aligns with faithfulness to God and obedience to His will.
